   - In Outlook, click the “Calendar” icon at the bottom left.
   - In the calendar, navigate to Wednesday, Dec 9.

   - Double‑click the “Research Sync” meeting at 2:00–3:00 pm to open it.
   - Make sure the window title says “Meeting – Research Sync” (not just an appointment).

   - In the “Start time” field:
     - Click the date drop‑down and change it from Dec 9 to Dec 10.

     - End time: 3:00 PM
   - Confirm the “Time zone” (small text next to the times or under “Time Zones”) shows Central Time.

4. Save and send updates
   - In the top-left of the meeting window, click “Send Update”.
   - This saves the new date/time and sends an updated invite to all attendees.

- Nothing at 2:00–3:00 pm on Wed, Dec 9.
